gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-lim: Noto Sans Limbu has a friendly, contemporary build, with gaping curves and small letters that stand surprisingly upright on the line. Impact Label shouts; this one converses.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-lyd: Approachable and unfussy, Noto Sans Lydian keeps its capitals barely above the lowercase, and its openings spread wide like a sprung paper clip. Under Impact Label's heavy shout, it simply keeps talking.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-mah: Modern and businesslike, Noto Sans Mahajani lifts its lowercase close to the capitals and funnels each e wide open. And Impact Label hammers its heavy, commanding display letters above it, so the body reads gently by comparison.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-mar: Crisp and punchy, Impact Label stamps each letter out alone, its c ends flaring apart like pincers. And Noto Sans Marchen follows with almost capital-sized small letters, whose curves end in clear daylight.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-may: Contemporary and businesslike, Noto Sans Mayan Numerals gapes its c wide at any size. Over a long page, those upright small letters keep going comfortably, while Impact Label above it stays loud and heavy.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-mee: Impact Label spaces every letter apart, with a high-set x-height and c ends flaring like open pincers. And Noto Sans Meetei Mayek answers with big-eyed lowercase and rounds that gap like a cracked bangle, a modern texture over many lines.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-men: Impact Label is the commanding one, heavy letters standing apart with c ends flared like open pincers. And Noto Sans Mende Kikakui does the opposite job, letting daylight through every curve while its lowercase stands close to capital height.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-mod: Clean and modern, Noto Sans Modi lets daylight into every curve and keeps its capitals close to lowercase height. And over a full page, that low contrast lets lines run smoothly beneath Impact Label's heavy, commanding heading.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-mon: Contemporary and sturdy, Noto Sans Mono spaces its letters so none ever bump. Paragraphs of it read large and generous, with open curves that make a fine foil for Impact Label's heavy, commanding headline.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-mro: Impact Label brings commanding weight, with letters set apart and c ends flaring like open pincers, while Noto Sans Mro makes words look dense in the middle. Heavy shout, sturdy body.
